articles.title: SB360, Hilco Global, and Gordon Brothers Approved to Operate Going Out of Business Sales at All Remaining Value City Furniture and American Signature Furniture Stores
articles.mainIdea: SB360, Hilco Global, and Gordon Brothers Approved to Operate Going Out of Business Sales at All Remaining Value City Furniture and American Signature Furniture Stores
articles.summary: PR Newswire: SB360, Hilco Global, and Gordon Brothers Approved to Operate Going Out of Business Sales at All Remaining Value City Furniture and American Signature Furniture Stores. A joint venture of SB360 Capital Partners, Hilco Global, and Gordon Brothers has received bankruptcy court approval to operate Going Out of Business (GOB) sales in all 89 remaining American Signature Inc. ("ASI" or the "Company") stores. ASI is one of the nation's leading home furnishings retailers, and is the parent company of Value City Furniture ("VCF") and American Signature Furniture ("ASF"). articles.title: Compass and Anywhere Real Estate Begin a New Chapter as One Company Built for Real Estate Professionals
articles.mainIdea: Compass and Anywhere Real Estate Begin a New Chapter as One Company Built for Real Estate Professionals
articles.summary: PR Newswire: Compass and Anywhere Real Estate Begin a New Chapter as One Company Built for Real Estate Professionals. Compass, Inc. (NYSE: COMP) announces the completion of its all-stock combination with Anywhere Real Estate Inc. Following the merger, the two companies are coming together with a collective vision to become the best company in the world at empowering real estate professionals with everything they need to succeed and realize their entrepreneurial potential. An Open Letter from Robert Reffkin to real estate professionals, affiliate broker-owners, and employees is available here. Related tickers mentioned: COMP, HOUS.
